plan.notes: Official CSUDH 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, English B.A. program page, English Education Concentration 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid). Semester sums reconcile exactly with printed Hours; total 120. GENUINE CATALOG TYPOS PRESERVED VERBATIM: 'GE Area 4A Perspetives on Individuals, Groups, and Societies' (Sem 1) and 'GE 1B Critical Thinkng' (Sem 3). 'HIS 101 or POL 101' and 'ENG 202 or 203 or 204', 'ENG 240 or 241', 'ENG 342 or 345 or 346 or 347', 'ENG 457 or Elective Course', 'ENG 485 or Elective Course' modeled as choice slots with code = first-listed option per convention. The four 'Extended Studies Course' slots (12 units) require completing one field in full: Communications (COM 250, 301, 338, 346), Literature (ENG 306, 308, one of 325/326/327, one of 465/476/477), TESL (ENG 210, 317, 486, one of 420/492), Theatre Arts (THE 322, 337, 353, 374), or Rhetoric and Composition (ENG 457 or 485, ENG 451 or 472, ENG 473, ENG 478). ENG 490 satisfies GWAR per source. UNV 300 (2 units) should be taken concurrently with ENG 485 or ENG 487 per catalog note. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented; sequencing follows the official roadmap order.
